name: core
description: Working-style rules for Claude Code, loaded into each session by a SessionStart hook, plus guard hooks that start in dry-run.

name: core-bundle
description: The everyday set: working-style rules, guard hooks, session mods, and general-purpose skills. Needs nothing beyond Claude Code, python3, git and jq; a few mods are macOS only.

name: multi-agent
description: Tools for running several agents side by side and handing work between them. Needs herdr and tuios installed; Codex and agy are optional; dispatch-router needs a TypeSafe key.

name: research
description: Paper search, science, web and video research skills plus a subreddit watcher. Needs a free alphaXiv account for the paper search server, and ffmpeg and yt-dlp for watch.

name: design
description: Design and diagram skills and plugins for interfaces, motion, accessibility and technical figures. Needs nothing; design-direction is macOS only.

name: jev
description: Mods and skills built on the TypeSafe (Jev) models. Needs a TypeSafe API key, paid per call.

name: writing
description: Skills for writing and editing prose that reads like a person wrote it. Needs nothing.

name: media
description: Skills for video and image generation. Some need a paid image or video key.
